info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Methods-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods Retrieval API allows users to fetch a list of available payment methods for processing transactions. This endpoint supports various business scenarios, such as integrating payment solutions in e-commerce platforms or financial applications. Developers can leverage this API to streamline checkout experiences for consumers by providing them with a variety of payment options. Typical users include merchants and service providers looking to enhance their payment offerings and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve a list of all available payment methods that can be used for transactions. It provides detailed information about each payment method, helping users to select their preferred options.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving available payment methods. This request allows clients to specify any necessary parameters to customize the response, ensuring relevant payment methods are returned based on the criteria provided.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to payment methods. It is expected to be a string.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsResponse_204.title: Payments Methods Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the payment processing.

state.description: The current state of the payment process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment processing.

audit.description: Audit information related to the payment processing.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response of the GET operation for payment methods.
